methods.binaryBytes: stat of build/DustBar.app/Contents/MacOS/DustBar after scripts/bundle.sh (release, stripped, ad-hoc signed)
methods.idleFootprintMB: fresh copy via open -n, popover closed, vmmap -summary 'Physical footprint:' read after 60 s idle
methods.idleFootprint5minMB: same as idleFootprintMB, read after 300 s idle; only with --long (previous value kept otherwise)
methods.idleSeconds: length of the idle window in seconds (60 default, 300 with --long)
methods.idleCpuPct: mean of ps -o %cpu= sampled every 5 s over the idle window
methods.scan1MSeconds: DUSTBAR_SCAN_BENCH=~/Library swift test --filter scanBench; BENCH elapsed line; 'scan1M' label is the ~/Library tree as the bench scans it
methods.scan1MFiles: files count printed by the scanBench BENCH line
methods.scan8MSeconds: DUSTBAR_SCAN_BENCH=~ swift test --filter scanBench; only with --full (previous value kept otherwise)
methods.scan8MFiles: files count printed by scanBench on ~; only with --full
methods.refreshSpeedup: full scan time / incremental refresh time of 20 random dirs (DUSTBAR_REFRESH_BENCH=1 swift test --filter refreshBench, ~/Library)
methods.refreshFullSeconds: full scan time from the refreshBench REFRESH line
methods.refreshIncrementalSeconds: refresh time of 20 dirty directories from the refreshBench REFRESH line
methods.date: UTC timestamp of the measurement run
methods.warmCache: warm cache: no sudo purge; numbers reflect a warm disk cache
